therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Atorvastatin vs Fish Oil Supplement vs Placebo
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: anti-inflammatory effects to reduce post-operative atrial fibrillation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients undergoing thoracic surgery for lung cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: incidence of atrial fibrillation during first 4 days after lung resection

dose_info.dose: Atorvastatin: 1 capsule daily; Fish Oil: 3 capsules twice daily
dose_info.schedule: 5 days before surgery and 9 days after surgery or until discharge
